blockingIssues.description: Initial multi-day map auto-zoom fits only the default highlighted day instead of the full trip route, violating the expected full-route fit on load.
Elevation chart does not satisfy required axis labeling/units: expected ft/m Y-axis and distance X-axis labeling, but current chart only shows imperial corner badges without full axis labels.
Route animation progress is not reset after completion or route change, so Play does not reliably restart from the beginning, violating expected control behavior.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly prohibit AskUser usage in non-interactive mission/exec runs and require autonomous default decision-making when clarification would otherwise be requested.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: elevation-chart review observed AskUser tool failure in non-interactive worker session 398af245-6616-460d-be33-bb7dad5756b6.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a documented fallback path for manual browser verification requirements when feature scope is non-UI (e.g., test/lint remediation) or when interactive verification is infeasible in mission execution.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both elevation-chart and fix-maps-lint-and-tests reviews reported mismatch between strict manual verification requirement and practical completion flow for those features.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify TDD requirement scope (new behavior vs. remediation-only changes) and expected evidence for red/green so reviewers can distinguish process non-compliance from acceptable exceptions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: map-and-route-display and fix-maps-lint-and-tests reviews flagged procedure ambiguity around strict red/green expectations for mixed implementation/fix workflows.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add shared-state guidance about VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY discovery/location.
Update shared state because one worker did not run full validators required by skill.
